title: Alias
overview: Alias, a lovable green Pure, embarks on a rescue mission to save his friends and to secure the stolen jewelry of his People.

title: SMTOWN LIVE 2025-26 in FUKUOKA
overview: 2025 marks SM Entertainment's 30th anniversary, celebrated with performances around the world.  Now, SM artists are gathering in Fukuoka!  They'll ignite Mizuho PayPay Dome Fukuoka with powerful performances filled with love for all fans.  Experience the spectacular live show featuring SM Entertainment artists all together in one place, live and in real time. The lineup of artists includes TVXQ, SUPER JUNIOR,  HYOYEON (Girls’ Generation), MINHO (SHINee), EXO, Red Velvet (IRENE & SEULGI & JOY), NCT 127,  aespa, NCT DREAM, WayV, RIIZE, NCT WISH, Hearts2Hearts, and XngHan&Xoul.

title: The Gayma Wards
overview: While hosting a parody awards show, everything starts to go wrong. Presenters are sabotaging, guests aren't showing up and the host is at their wits end.

title: Misery Signals: The Final Performance
overview: The Final Live performance from Misery Signals, recorded at Union Hall, Edmonton 10.19.24

title: Andre
overview: Andre inherits a small fortune, which pushes him into a series of surreal and aimless encounters with eccentric strangers.

title: Top 100 Craziest Jets Moments (2015 - 2025)
overview: "Top 100 Craziest Jets Moments" counts down the most unbelievable occurrences in Jets history since 2015. From player controversies to bizarre coaching decisions, this hilarious countdown features a slideshow of wild images and anecdotes. Prepare for a rollercoaster of unbelievable moments spanning a decade of Jets football.

title: A Year in The Life at MKBHD.
overview: We recorded... everything

title: Dominik Hašek: Always the Goalie
overview: Dominik Hašek, Olympic gold medalist and two-time Stanley Cup-winning goaltender, looks back on his life growing up in Pardubice, Czechoslovakia. His longest-tenured NHL team, the Buffalo Sabres, walk Hašek through his past to see how his love of hockey and the political and cultural influences of growing up in Pardubice molded him into one of the greatest goalies the sport has ever seen.

title: Tape Me
overview: Watch Me, Torture Me, Tape Me, follow Faceless as he catalogues his stalking, kidnapping and torturing of his victims. His victims range from privileged socialites and the financially desperate promised salvation through a deadly game.

title: Terri Joe: Missionary in Miami
overview: In this wild farce, Southern Belle Terri Joe ventures to Miami to outrun wacky criminals and find a new church where she can atone for her sins.

title: Four For One
overview: In this one-day dark comedy, an office worker hires assassins to get revenge after a co-worker steals credit for his promotion. Panicked, the credit thief hires private security, and the escalating paranoia is told from multiple perspectives-assassins, guards, and office staff-all racing toward an absurd final showdown over the pettiest feud imaginable.

title: Six String Sky
overview: As family pressures and authority figures try to shut them down, two high school friends fight for one shot to share their voices and pursue their dreams of becoming musicians.

title: Western Simulacrum
overview: Inspired by the writings of Jean Baudrillard, this film - shot entirely within the videogame Red Dead Redemption 2 - examines people's perception of history, in this case the Wild West period, and how it has been influenced by media representation and recreation, or perhaps how it has been entirely replaced by it.

title: GRAND PIANO SHOW Koncerto Filmas
overview: Pianist Ieva Dūdaitė, who rewrote Lithuanian history, presents a film of her Grand Piano Show tour concert. In the film, the pianist opens the doors to the arena and talks about what the audience did not see – behind the scenes, family support, challenges, audience reactions, and intense preparations with a team of 46 people. Launched in the winter of 2024, the Grand Piano Show tour combined classical, popular, and hip-hop music genres, dance and aerial acrobatics performances, and amazed audiences with a glowing piano. and attracted nearly 10,000 spectators in Vilnius, Kaunas, and Palanga, receiving the highest ratings from the audience. The Grand Piano Show concert film captures moments from all three tour performances, behind-the-scenes footage, and genuine emotions. In the film, I. Dūdaitė also talks openly about her childhood, family support, her musical mission, the intense preparation stage, challenges, and the impact of this tour on the younger generation.

title: Sirena
overview: Micaella Raz ignites the screen as she plays a mythic siren who feeds on sexual energy, draining men in exchange for prosperity. A fisherman accidentally caught her and offers himself. When his wife learns the truth, she too makes a sacrifice for the sake of their family.

title: Wicked of Oz
overview: A freak tornado pulls Dorothy Gale into the wicked world of Oz just in time for the down-on-her-luck Kansas farm girl to confront Glinda, a starving cannibal who finds herself all out of Munchkin meat. Things go downhill from there, as Dorothy goes head-to-head (literally) against a skull-cracking Scarecrow, a Tin Man whose hobby is to collect still-beating hearts and a Cowardly Lion who pleases his master by ripping apart anyone he sees. Oz becomes Ooze as Dorothy – armed with scavenged weapons – battles her way through hordes of psychotic enemies until she finally happens upon her ultimate nemesis, the Wicked of Oz.

title: Addition
overview: Numbers are everything to Grace Lisa Vandenburg. The life of Grace, a Melbourne-based mathematician, is largely governed by her arithmomania, an obsessive-compulsive need to count (three times to ensure accuracy) everything from the poppy seeds on her cake to the bristles on her toothbrush. In a chaotic, sometimes tragic, and constantly changing world, Grace’s preoccupation gives her a sense of order and control. And she does her best to lead a “normal” life, spending time with her mother and sister, her beloved niece Larry… and a manifestation of the late inventor and engineer Nikola Tesla who is Grace’s closest confidante.

title: Velvicide
overview: The two lives of a suicide hotline operator and a recently kidnapped trauma survivor collide in this tale of botched suicide and unconventional redemption.

title: Emoji - It's Complicated
overview: Emoji is a romance drama between Aadhav and Deeksha. Usually, couples get into fights because of misunderstandings. But this couple gets pulled away because they have excessive understanding. Isn't it interesting? Can love win them back together? Meet the vibrant young couple.

title: Hooleta
overview: The feature film "Hooleta" is a painfully honest look at the mental health crisis among today's youth.  Emma - a young girl caught in the eye of a domestic storm. Struggling with the fallout of a fractured family, she searches for the missing pieces of love and belonging in all the wrong places.  At school pressures mount and relationships crumble, Emma's life becomes a balancing act between self-destruction and the desperate hope for a new beginning.  This is an intimate, emotional journey of a girl fighting to reclaim her identity from the wreckage of her daily life.

title: Bight
overview: Two couples' daring foray into open relationships leads down a tumultuous path of jealousy, betrayal, and emotional devastation.

title: Blackout
overview: After a nuclear strike devastates California, a group of veterans and criminals trapped in a warehouse must fight to survive marauders, radiation, and each other in a world where the line between good and evil is gone.

title: Bagong Tukso
overview: Meet the freshest faces of VMX! Apphle Celso, Margaret Diaz, Heart Fox, and Allison Ross turn up the heat, bare fantasies, and tease you into an unforgettable sexy experience.

title: Enemy in My House
overview: Enemy in My House is a live-filmed stage play blending mystery, suspense, comedy, faith, and an unforgettable twist. Journalist Monique Daniels is newly married, expecting her first child, and grateful to God for her many blessings—until Harmony, a new assistant from the news station, enters her life.  What begins as casual workdays quietly spirals into daily drama as secrets, sabotage, and temptation rise to the surface. Someone is determined to destroy Monique’s family, her career, and her peace. As the tension escalates, her instincts as an investigative journalist sharpen, drawing her into a dangerous search for the truth.  In a gripping unraveling of deception, Monique is forced to confront a devastating reality: the news anchor isn’t just reporting the headline—she’s become it.  A tense, emotional roller coaster captured live on stage, Enemy in My House delivers powerful performances, sharp storytelling, and a shocking ending that leaves audiences breathless.

title: Untitled Home Invasion Romance
overview: As a last-ditch attempt to save his failing marriage, an actor stages a home invasion during a romantic getaway weekend.

title: NO: Mexican Animation Doesn’t Matter
overview: Mexican animation does not have an audience to grow, nor an economic industry to sustain itself, but that does not prevent the existence of auteur works. “No” is a feature-length documentary which explores the circumstances and uncomfortable truths of Mexican animation beyond the cheap rhetoric. Based on data and extensive research into distribution values, box office figures, perception, and the international landscape in which Mexican animation finds itself.

title: Tracking the Wendigo
overview: A history of encounters in Edmonton and British Columbia.

title: biarkan aku ganti
overview: a woman experiences the same day...but is it a time loop?

title: A Super Progressive Movie
overview: When their rainbow malfunctions, four progressives journey beyond the insulated “Naarm Bubble” into a real world led by Prime Minister Pauline Hanson, searching for their ideology’s most powerful weapon: the Victimhood.

title: In the Blink of an Eye
overview: Three storylines, spanning thousands of years, intersect and reflect on hope, connection and the circle of life.

title: Maybe Tomorrow
overview: The story follows Kurdish forces' 18-month fight against ISIS from 2016-2017, highlighting women's role, international volunteers, key battles like Manbij and Raqqa, and civilian life under Kurdish self-rule.

title: Whispered Voices
overview: Orphaned siblings Mikaeel & Jane clash over leaving home. Mikaeel's situation worsens with eerie whispers; a vengeful past resurfaces.

title: White Prince
overview: After fleeing an abusive partner, a loyal real estate finds refuge with a stranger whose quiet kindness blurs the line between friendship and intimacy.

title: The Male Gaze: Wild Youth
overview: Witness how human nature can reveal that there are forces within us that are either challenged by - or reflected in - the people and environments that surround us in these five short films from around the world that take a closer look at the gay experience.

title: The Era of Her
overview: Before I turned 30, I felt like I was on a countdown. There is a traditional concept that turning 30 brings. It’s supposed to be a time when big things happen. But when I turned thirty I realized, nothing happened at all.  The term “middle-aged woman” has a unique power. Women between 30 and 50 often lose a little bit of the childishness and chaos of their 20s. They’re relatively more organized and relatively sure of themselves, but at the same time face some of the biggest life challenges.  As a stand-up comedian, I’m fortunate that my job makes me think about a lot of perspectives and attitudes, and forces me to create ideas, which in turn end up contributing to me being a more complex person. I like complexity. The world is not black and white. There is no point in having only one ray of light, if it is like a rainbow with many paths, it’s definitely more interesting.

title: TWIN
overview: Fresh out of prison for murder, a ruthless woman schemes to replace her twin sister and claim her flawless life by any means necessary.

title: Claim Me
overview: Cess Garcia and VMX’s next big thing Dara Lima star in a steamy drama about two sisters and the man who sparks their sensual awakening. A female lawyer hires a young man as tutor for her younger sister but unknown to her, their review sessions are becoming wild

title: Closure
overview: After his teenage son goes missing, Daniel scours the depths of the Vistula River, torn between the dread of a fatal leap and the hope that his son may still be alive.

title: Honey Bunch
overview: Diana's husband is taking her to an experimental trauma facility deep in the wilderness, but she can't remember why... As her memories begin to creep back in so do some unwelcome sinister truths about her marriage.

title: Border 2
overview: During the events of the 1971 Indo-Pak war, a new generation of young Indian warriors were getting ready to defend the nation from an even bigger threat to the Indian motherland.

title: The Well
overview: In a world where environmental collapse has left survivors to fight for the precious resources needed to survive, a young woman’s loyalties are tested by the arrival of a wounded man. When he discovers her family has a secret supply of fresh water it puts them all in the crosshairs of a dangerous cult, and their ruthless leader Gabriel.

title: In Cold Light
overview: Fresh out of prison, Ava's attempt to reclaim her drug operation collapses when she witnesses a brutal crime, forcing her to flee into a nightmarish underworld where allies are scarce and enemies multiply by the minute.

title: Baby Girl
overview: It was a special day in hospital attendant Sanal’s life: his wife, who had been working abroad for many years was finally coming home to be with him and their child, who she had missed dearly. Now their little family would be complete.

title: Meteoric 3
overview: The final chapter of the Meteoric series follows a group of visual documentation specialists for the US military as they search for creative inspiration in the California desert. Shot entirely between January 1 and December 31, 2025.

title: The Mail Lady 3
overview: Hiding off the grid with Derek's newborn son, vengeful ex-mail carrier Sloan Redding orchestrates one last deadly scheme to claim her twisted family, forcing Derek into a life-or-death showdown to save them.

title: Saucers, Spooks and Kooks
overview: Saucers Spooks and Kooks explores how disinformation helped fuel the UFO myth and how that fog continues to cloud what we think we know about UFOs to this day. Tropes like the "Greys," underground bases, and crashed saucers live on today.

title: Sandhya Nama Upasate
overview: The war never ends—it only changes its battlefield, from power and pride to wealth, and now to health and humanity. COVID pushed the world into unseen trenches, where survival itself became a daily conflict and solitude a shared emotion.

title: A World Gone Mad - The War Diaries of Astrid Lindgren
overview: “Pippi Longstocking“ has been translated into 70 languages and sold more than 60 million copies. The film tells the story of her “mother“, famous Swedish author Astrid Lindgren. When young an still unknown, she starts a diary on September 1, 1939. Full of despair about the world, she is in conversation with herself and discovers the healing power of writing. As WWII ends with millions dead and the destruction of Europe, her first book about rebellious Pippi is published.

title: Return to Silent Hill
overview: When James receives a mysterious letter from his lost love Mary, he is drawn to Silent Hill—a once-familiar town now consumed by darkness. As he searches for her, James faces monstrous creatures and unravels a terrifying truth that will push him to the edge of his sanity.

title: House Sitter
overview: While house-sitting for the mysterious and wealthy Harold Finch, three friends find themselves hunted by a masked killer. As they fight to survive, chilling clues hidden throughout the home reveal that this suburban nightmare may be part of something far more sinister…

title: Sulutan
overview: Lena and Mara are drawn into a secret affair that defies boundaries and threatens everything they’ve built. When Mara uncovers her groom’s betrayal, she finds solace in Lena, a newfound friend who soon becomes something more. As passion and secrecy collide, their choices endanger careers, fracture relationships, and lead to devastating consequences.

title: The Forsaken
overview: After discovering an old book, Alex becomes drawn into the harrowing stories of cowboys Latt and Stylz. As he reads about their treasure hunt and daring adventures, Alex finds inspiration in their courage and friendship to use in his own life and help him find the strength to overcome his own obstacles.

title: Gili: Raar, hè?!
overview: In Raar, hè?!, comedian and mentalist Gili brings together his favorite acts full of magic, mentalism, humor, and deception into one ultimate show for all generations, featuring both best-of moments and brand-new surprises.

title: Every 1920s Mickey Mouse Short Film
overview: Every public domain Mickey Mouse short film from the 1920s, compiled as a single viewable feature film! From 1928-1929 (Although a couple were made in 1927 but not widely distributed yet), there were 15 films in the Mickey Mouse series, all of which are now Public Domain. This also happens to be all the Mickey Mouse shorts that were distributed by Celebrity Productions. In fact this film itself is public domain, you may use it for whatever you like, no copyright or trademark!  This compilation is not authorized, endorsed or approved by The Walt Disney Company. The Walt Disney Company is not associated with this compilation film or the producer and editor Jenny Livingstone.

title: Retrospection
overview: Timothee and Hope reunite after years apart under mysterious circumstances. As the key to the future, they must race against time to prevent a radical organization, led by Agent 5010 and his counterparts, from exploiting their special abilities.

title: MyRoad Away-Ahead
overview: While basking in the glory of their naturalistic digital home, a child mistakenly clips outside its boundaries, beginning a chain of events that ultimately lead to its erasure.

title: GrimTrax Returns
overview: Like a comet streaking across the sky with a trail of suffering, ennui, and industrial puncture wounds behind it, GrimTrax Returns! Five shorts too grim to release individually, including one we recorded TWO YEARS AGO and held onto for just this moment.

title: Lua de Sangue 3: O Último Capítulo
overview: Helena and her friends embark on one final investigation, determined to uncover a secret capable of revealing the whole truth about the Reaper, a masked killer who forever marked their lives. The past returns, the mask begins to fall, and there is no more escape.

title: Sam Cyr et Marylène Gendron : Séparés mais ensemble
overview: A comedy special featuring Sam Cyr and Marylène Gendron, each delivering 45 minutes of witty, endearing, and refreshingly bold humor.

title: Randam Mukham
overview: A neglected wife flees with her young son and a seemingly kind driver, seeking a better life. But when she discovers the man's true predatory nature, she must fight to protect her son from a horrifying fate.

title: Safia/Safdar
overview: When Salman falls ill, his saloon is at stake as the local moneylender wants it. The only person standing in the way is Salman's daughter, Safia. Will she be able to keep the salon running as Safdar?

title: Dracula Eternal
overview: A woman's idyllic summer is shattered when her best friend falls ill, her fiancé vanishes, and she's drawn into a terrifying battle against an ancient evil in this modern re-imagining of Bram Stoker's Dracula.

title: Thank You for Coming
overview: The play revolves around a singer from a working-class neighborhood named Zalabia who dreams of fame. A maestro discovers her and supports her in achieving her artistic dream, leading her through numerous challenges and lessons along the way.

title: Aatka
overview: After his grandmother’s death, finance graduate Fayaz returns to Bangladesh. Torn between family expectations and his dream of opening a salon, he moves forward with the support of his childhood friend Chumki, his cousin Muniya, and an unexpected ghostly presence.

title: Kid Yugi - Genesis and Rise of an Anti-Idol
overview: Genesis and Rise of an Anti-Idol traces Kid Yugi's journey from his origins in the provinces to his success on the Italian rap scene, exploring the construction of an artistic identity based on the rejection of exposure and the role of idol. Through images, archival material, and personal reflections, the documentary recounts the birth of a dark and literary imagination, the centrality of writing as a form of survival, and the conflictual relationship with success. What emerges is the portrait of an artist who transforms isolation into language and rise to fame into an act of resistance, maintaining a conscious distance from the public and the logic of the industry.

title: Land Looters
overview: Part travelogue and part sensitive investigation, the movie tells the universal story of people who refuse to be erased, reminding us that defending the Earth means defending life.

title: Southside Kev
overview: South-Side Kev follows a misguided teenager as he navigates the mean streets of South Jamaica Queens, struggling to find the balance between earning respect and maintaining his innocence.

title: Welsh Ghost Story
overview: A group of students carry out an investigation into the murder of a lonely farmer, Edwyn Morris and the subsequent paranormal events that have occurred after his death. During their investigation it becomes clear that something sinister is lurking in the details of the murder and there is much more to Edwyn's history than originally meets the eye. As they delve deeper into the paranormal investigation, they soon begin to realise that they themselves are at risk and are to become part of an investigation where they are the victims.

title: O Thee, Aeon
overview: A person must arise, have a telephone call, and go for a walk. There are many pitfalls on this journey.  A depraved debunking of Slow Cinema.

title: Elalli - The Untold Story
overview: Raghavendra, a small curious boy, sets out to uncover a hidden truth of a village named "Elalli", a small town in the coastal region of Karnataka. He gets in trouble with the local don, then after many trials, brings back the original name of the village "Hasuralli" to "Elalli".

title: Ícaro: la semana en llamas
overview: The documentary chronicles the week the streets burned, police charged against crowds, and Barcelona experienced the five most chaotic days in its recent history. When the Supreme Court sentenced the 12 pro-independence leaders for sedition, misuse of public funds, and disobedience, the widespread rejection of the verdict sparked a wave of demonstrations, protests, and violent clashes that transformed the streets of Barcelona, ​​and other cities in Catalonia, into a veritable battlefield.

title: Camp Blood Legacy
overview: A group of college friends run into the infamous killer clown at Camp Black Tree as he slices and dices his way through them. One year later, the sole survivor returns with her friends to settle the score, once and for all.  This is the "lost" original version of Camp Blood 4 and Camp Blood 5, first released in 2016. Starring Schuylar Craig (Nemesis 5) and Jennii Caroline from the Meathook Massacre series. From cult filmmaker Dustin Ferguson (Witchcraft XVII, Spider Baby).

title: Breastfriends Forever
overview: Beauty-and-breasts besties Astrid Lee and Audrey Avila team up with sharp-tongued detective and comedy legend Janno Gibbs to solve the hilarious case of men getting way too - well, inflated.

title: Have A Word: Harry Day
overview: Have A Word's very own Make-A-Wish kid Harry is given his dream day - including body slams, head-on helmet collisions (not a euphemism) and dangerous driving. Happy Harry Day.

title: Bulls
overview: Two down-on-their-luck half-brothers run a failing dive bar in Indiana and get a shot at taking on England’s elite darts champions.

title: Death Name
overview: A young Korean American woman yearns to learn more about her heritage, not knowing the further she digs, the more she reawakens a deadly family curse.

title: Hunter Among Us
overview: A group video call unhinges when one friend threatens suicide online. Next - hijacking their feed, a masked hacker turns the group’s desperate attempts to save their friend into a sadistic mind game.

title: Hands
overview: In a world of elite underground fighters, a couple tries to prove they are the best against a greedy rival and a merciless hired gun. They soon have to choose between winning and vengeance.

title: The Words
overview: 4 years ago, rocker bad-boy Phoenix broke nerdy good-girl Lennon's heart and stole her song to escape his abusive father. Now he's a famous rockstar, spiraling into drugs and alcohol, she's hired to keep him sober for 8 weeks on tour. Can Lennon and Phoenix heal old wounds, or will their past stand in the way of their second chance at love?

title: Elvis: A Life in Music
overview: A retrospective on the life of the legendary entertainer Elvis Presley, featuring the most significant moments of his career.

title: What Happened To Maria?
overview: Seeking refuge from a past she can't outrun, Maria returns home. But when an unexpected connection with a gentle stranger stirs hope for something more, she's forced to confront the truth: love can't always save us from who we've been.

title: Kayla
overview: Discovering she's been betrayed, a scorned woman’s obsession spirals into stalking, secrets, and a twisted new romance as revenge blurs into danger.

title: COUNTDOWN CONCERT 2025-2026 STARTO to MOVE
overview: Twelve groups from STARTO ENTERTAINMENT hold their first countdown concert at Tokyo Dome in three years.

title: THE FINAL NIGHT
overview: Years of working at Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria have left Ralph's life in ruins. Hoping that leaving the company will finally give him a chance to piece things back together, he must endure one more night of flickering lights and eerie animatronics. But on the day of his final shift, strange things begin happening causing Ralph to confront the dark truth about Freddy's and his own role in its sinister history, turning the usual routine of monitoring cameras and managing limited power into a fight for his life as he tries to survive his final night at Freddy Fazbears.

title: Demon Hunters
overview: In the blistering desert stands Dee's Money Pit, a strip club where sinners come to drink—and die. When two bikers cross the wrong dancers, their slaughter sparks a collision between a ragtag crew of exorcists, a pair of naïve missionaries, and a homeless drifter with secrets of his own.

title: Death Cipher
overview: A disgraced journalist makes a horrifying discovery about an online puzzle that causes people to disappear.

title: President: A Documentary about Sadyr Japarov
overview: The four-part documentary film "President" chronicles Sadyr Zhaparov's journey from opposition figure and prisoner to the head of state, highlighting key events of recent years.

title: A Very Good Boy
overview: From his childhood in a modest family in the Pyrénées to his unexpected career as a porn actor in the 1970s, the film traces the life of Claude Loir, who set out to fully embrace life. His homosexuality and curiosity guide him through encounters that lead into the shadowy, liberated circles of a pre-AIDS era, caught between conservatism and sexual freedom. Loves and lovers, flamboyance and fragility… the film offers a striking portrait of a fearless, hedonistic man navigating desire, identity, and society’s constraints.

title: CFNY: The Spirit of Radio
overview: In 1976, CFNY launched in a small suburban house just north of Toronto and went on to become one of the most influential punk, new wave and alternative radio stations in the world. This is the story of their mission to bring the most exciting music in the world to the masses. It's also a story of the personalities, lawsuits, bankruptcies, concerts, and listener protests that went along with it.

title: Cabaret Absinthe
overview: In the Emerald City, two conjoined sisters, cabaret dancers Ligéia and Séraphine, drift between dimensions, sustained by the visions of a witch-mother who weaves their fate. Through their wanderings and fractured dreams emerge a shadowed magician and an enigmatic beast, avatars of desire and covetous longing. A hallucinatory tale with the bitterness of absinthe, the film summons metamorphosis through a sensual, dream-born odyssey. A haunting exploration of twinship, where bodies divide, seek one another, and become doorways to other worlds.

title: Somewhere In The Sky(Live from the Hollywood Bowl)
overview: Step inside AJR’s spectacular Somewhere in the Sky Tour as their sold-out performance from the iconic Hollywood Bowl comes to life in this special livestream event. Filmed under the open Los Angeles sky, the show captures the band’s signature fusion of theatrical production, inventive visuals, and emotionally charged alt-pop anthems, all amplified by the magic of one of the world’s most legendary venues.

title: 119 Emergency Call 2026 YOKOHAMA BLACKOUT
overview: New Year SP set one year after the series: at Yokohama City Fire Dept.’s command center on New Year’s holiday, an AI dispatcher plan sparks debate, then a massive blackout hits, swamping operators with life-or-death calls.

title: Nass VS Jimmy Negatron
overview: The feature length culmination to a decade of lore shows the nefarious Jimmy Negatron psychologically and physically tormenting a fat douchebag in his quest for infinite power. Watch in mortal terror as Negatron falls deeper into the endless void of insanity as he tortures, maims, and brutalizes his way to immortality in this cult horror classic.

title: AJR: Live from the Hollywood Bowl
overview: Step inside AJR’s spectacular Somewhere in the Sky Tour as their sold-out performance from the iconic Hollywood Bowl comes to life in this special livestream event. Filmed under the open Los Angeles sky, the show captures the band’s signature fusion of theatrical production, inventive visuals, and emotionally charged alt-pop anthems, all amplified by the magic of one of the world’s most legendary venues.  Join Adam, Jack, and Ryan for a night packed with soaring new songs, bold re-imaginations of fan favourites, and the playful storytelling that transforms every AJR show into an immersive experience.

title: 86 printemps, Jean-Luc Godard
overview: Documentary film about (and featuring) Jean-Luc Godard, shot in Rolle, Switzerland, in January 2017.

title: Varun Grover: Nothing Makes Sense
overview: Varun Grover in his first-ever stand-up special, can't make sense about African Cheetahs landing in India, growing up as a Punjabi, nostalgia for the 90s, increasing intolerance, intergenerational trauma, IRCTC website and it's obsession with captcha and threats to free speech in the biggest democracy in the world.

title: The Year: 2025
overview: Robin Roberts hosts a look back at the top stories, trends and entertainment obsessions that defined the last 12 months.

title: Broken Bonds
overview: After witnessing a fatal shootout, three struggling waitresses hide a bag of illicit cash, forcing them into a perilous web of betrayal and survival.

title: Blood and Betrayal
overview: A thriving restaurant and a crime lord-when passion and revenge intertwine, love can be just as deadly as a loaded gun. Eva is married to the owner of a restaurant in the downtown London back alleys. However, when she begins an passionate affair with another man and the couple begin being black mailed £500,000 otherwise their secret will be exposed a shocking twist of erotic gun violence breaks.

title: In Their Own Time
overview: In Their Own Time is a narrative journey of three women - Srija, Tuhnu, and Jhumur, as they reflect on love, loss, childhood, friendship, and belonging over three years; we never see their faces, as the evolution of their experiences is manifested by an inherently dynamic and increasingly personal kaleidoscope of the city and suburbs of Kolkata.

title: Hannah Slaughter
overview: A trans woman returns home.

title: Over the Rainbow
overview: A small town is consumed by a missing person case.

title: Cojo Feliz: La Peor Pluma de México
Trevor Noah: The LOST South African Show
overview: Trevor Noah's first South African Special in 8 years! Filmed in Tshwane in 2023 in front of 8000+ South Africans the show takes us back into the thick of all the questions we had "Cupcake has a couch?!?" "Will loadshedding ever end?!?" "Robots have new management?!?"

title: Indie Author
overview: Indie Author is a movie for the dreamers of the world. They say that if you do what you love for a living, you'll never work a day in your life. For most authors, writing is their passion, but the odds have always been stacked against them. Enter the underdogs, the people who didn't let anything stand between them and the impossible. They are the daydreamers, the romantics, and the storytellers who found what it takes to earn a full-time living from their craft and have built a community to help each other and defy the odds. Through their stories, you might find answers to launch your own writing career. At a minimum, you'll be entertained, inspired, and well-armed with the hard truths and inside facts if you choose the adventure of a writer's life.

title: From Vienna: The New Year’s Celebration 2026
overview: The famed Vienna Philharmonic rings in the New Year with its annual concert from Vienna's Musikverein conducted for the first time by Yannick Nézet-Séguin with performances by the Vienna State Ballet and location segments hosted by Hugh Bonneville.

title: Into the Spiral
overview: Tom, an ordinary guy, finds himself in a seemingly never-ending nightmare, forced to play many roles in many different fictional films—a spiral he must escape, or the filmmaker will keep him trapped within it.

title: TV4:s nyårskarameller 2025
overview: A star-studded evening from Berns in Stockholm awaits. Tilde de Paula Eby welcomes us and offers an evening of goodies from the year as well as throwbacks as TV4 celebrates its 35th anniversary. The guest list includes Petra Mede, David Hellenius, Carina Berg, Johan Glans, Linda Lindorff, Mauri Hermundsson and Camilla Hamid. Many gems are promised and even a sneak peek at what 2026 has to offer.

title: Breast Friends Forever
overview: Beauty-and-breasts besties Astrid Lee and Audrey Avila team up with sharp-tongued detective and comedy legend Janno Gibbs to solve the hilarious case of men getting way too… well, inflated.

title: Psych Siddhartha
overview: Siddharth's life is a string of misfortunes, losing love, money, and dignity, making him the unwitting star of a slum-based comedy of errors. Hope only reappears in the form of Shravya, a no-nonsense single mother. However, just as Siddharth begins to rebuild his life and pursue a chance at love, his past resurfaces to threaten everything.

title: The Morter - Termination Point
overview: In Manhattan, New York, an ordinary British man named Geraint Whitmore — known by many as Kinney, The Morter, or The Terminator — finds his life destroyed after being falsely accused of causing a concert bombing that killed dozens. Despite claiming he was far from the scene, he is arrested and humiliated by the media.  After years behind bars, Geraint is released but deeply changed. Determined to rebuild his name, he opens a luxurious entertainment complex called The Termine67 — part hotel, part mall, part gaming center. The name honors both his birth year (1967) and the Gen Z number “67”, making it popular among young people.  At first, the place becomes a symbol of hope and fun — flashing lights, games, and crowds. But Geraint’s quiet bitterness grows. He begins gathering people who feel wronged or abandoned by society — outcasts, hackers, criminals. Soon, The Termine67 transforms from a family attraction into a dark underground network.

title: I Swiped the Wrong One
overview: A typical rom-com with an atypical rom-com ending, I Swiped the Wrong One is the story of four thirtysomethings who attempt to navigate the world of 21st century online dating.

title: Labyrinth
overview: In the heart of Athens, there is another city. A hidden city. Α city breathing for almost more than a century under the artificial light. A documentary about the labyrinth of the arcades and the people living, working, and creating there for three generations. But in these arcades, Labyrinth discovers also a metaphor of cinema itself.
